chapters.title: A living hope
chapters.summary: God has given us new birth into a living hope through Jesus' resurrection. Trials refine faith like gold. Be holy, for you were redeemed by the precious blood of Christ.

chapters.title: Living stones
chapters.summary: You are living stones built into a spiritual house, a chosen people and royal priesthood. Christ suffered for you, leaving an example, and by His wounds you were healed.

chapters.title: A reason for your hope
chapters.summary: Wives and husbands honor one another. Do not repay evil for evil. Be ready to give a reason for the hope in you, with gentleness and respect.

chapters.title: Love covers sins
chapters.summary: Above all, love one another deeply, for love covers a multitude of sins. Use your gifts to serve. Do not be surprised by fiery trials.

chapters.title: Cast your cares on Him
chapters.summary: Elders, shepherd the flock willingly. Clothe yourselves with humility. Cast all your care on Him, for He cares for you. Resist the devil, who prowls like a lion.
